title: FreedomCraft
description: This mod spreads FREEDOM to Minecraft.
body:
FreedomCraft is a funny joke mod that adds just some silly American-themed mobs, foods, and structures to Minecraft, which can even be found in the survival game! There are some alright foods like tomatoes and lettuce that can be grown, and better ones that are comprised of many things, like slop. Yes, slop. There are mobs like Donald Trump, Joe Biden, and Barack Obama, foods like Pizza, Hot Dogs, Hamburgers, and Sodas, and there is even a new Chick-Fil-A structure!

_This mod is supposed to be funny, and should not be taken seriously._
